request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of the vendor TxPipe
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Tx3 by TxPipe, described as an open API layer for Cardano dApp protocols with developer and AI-agent-facing infrastructure.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 1,308,000 ADA plus a 327,000 ADA contingency reserve over 12 months, with a total withdrawal of 1,684,050 ADA including a 49,050 ADA Intersect budget administration fee.
Tx3 is intended to provide a common open-source interface for Cardano protocols, including documentation, multi-language SDKs, and live RPC endpoints.
The proposal asserts that Cardano currently lacks a common interface mechanism across the ecosystem, forcing integrators to relearn each protocol and raising integration costs.
The proposal states that Catalyst Fund 14 has already put Tx3's developer layer into production with 5 protocols live on the Tx3 Protocol Registry at tx3.land.
The proposal commits to onboarding 12 additional protocols, 3 per quarter, with developer and agent coverage, plus MCP server and skill framework development as shared registry infrastructure.
The proposal claims Tx3 already supports access to Strike Finance, Indigo Protocol, VyFinance, Bodega Market, and Fluid Tokens through its standardized interface.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved process.
The proposal states the requested amount does not, alone or in aggregate at submission, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.

TxPipe has received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals from Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 under development and on schedule, and also received 2025 Intersect maintenance funding for Pallas, Dolos, and UTxO RPC that is being delivered on schedule.

Funds will be administered through Intersect's 2026 treasury management smart contracts with named TRSC and PSSC addresses, role-based multi-signature permissions, external oversight entities, milestone-based disbursement controls, and an audit dashboard.

summary: The document requests 1,684,050 ADA for a 12-month TxPipe Tx3 project to expand a standardized protocol interface layer, onboard additional protocols, and add AI-agent-facing infrastructure, with Intersect-administered smart contract treasury controls and references for voting, audit, and contract oversight.
